ThingDef.label: bionic tail
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial tail. It also has a small AI that automatically balances the user's missing.

ThingDef.label: archotech ratkin tail
ThingDef.description: An artificial ratkin tail built by an archotech. It senses posture and micro-movements to keep the bearer perfectly balanced, feels like living flesh, and is harder to damage than plasteel. If harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its inner workings are a mystery.
